info.title: 同频 TONE API
info.description: MySQL-backed server. Registration and login use username and password only. WebSocket protocol is documented separately in docs/API.md and docs/PROTOCOL.md. Music is stored as direct provider URLs and expiry timestamps. See docs/API.md for bounded refresh, 100 MiB integrity verification.
